_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-07. CardID = 17600 + idx; 322 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 22). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [322, 17629].

Restriction band (LUKE CAGE, MISTY KNIGHT or ANY) and copies (xN printed on each card) read from the images; type, boost and text match unmatched-memory for all 13 titles. Luke Cage's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's and Bigfoot's: only deck.identity (data/tts/luke-cage.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Discrepancies with unmatched-memory (the real card wins): (1) the character card has a SECOND paragraph of the ability that unmatched-memory lacks: 'When defending, Luke Cage wins combat if he takes no damage even if he didn't play a card.' (the `ability` string below carries both paragraphs). (2) Skin Like Titanium prints value 0 (unmatched-memory: null), carried by `value` in its sheet entries. Restrictions are not in unmatched-memory at all.
Hero card (read from the image): LUKE CAGE, MELEE, START HEALTH 13, MOVE 2; sidekick MISTY KNIGHT, RANGED, START HEALTH 6 (the card prints the move once, 2, for both). One Misty Knight.
The first ability paragraph (2 less combat damage) is the passive rule combat_damage_reduction of the interpreter (data/heroes/effects/luke-cage.json); no counters, forms or triggers.
